bifrost: bifrost_app::attributed, bifrost_app::spellcheck, bifrost_ui::text, bifrost_ui::textfit, bifrost_ui::panels, render font engine
summary: Attributed strings, a rich text editing model, spell checking, a text editing and IME model, line breaking, a font panel and a font renderer exist. There is no multi-line text view widget, no TextKit layout manager and no Writing Tools.

features.feature: Text Display: attributed strings and rich text
features.note: bold, italic, size class, colour token, underline, strikethrough, link only; no paragraph styles, text attachments, lists or tables

features.feature: Text Display: single-line text field and editing model
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/text.rs (TextBuffer, TextEditor, marked text, grapheme movement, undo); docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Text input client'
features.note: editing commands, IME composition and key bindings covered

features.feature: Text Display: multi-line text view widget
features.note: docs/bifrost-ui.md states there is no multi-line text_view widget in the SDK

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (tokenizer, pluggable Dictionary, learned and ignored words)
features.note: no system-wide spelling panel or autocorrect UI in text views
link, date and phone detection only as documented in bifrost-ui.md

features.feature: Text Display: line breaking and truncation
features.note: head, middle, tail truncation and wrapping; no tab stops, indents or hyphenation
no glyph-level layout API for apps; layout is per widget

features.feature: TextKit: custom layout, text attachments, text lists, find bar
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget.
family, style and size only; no collections, effects or typography panes
TrueType, CFF and variable fonts render; no app-facing descriptor or trait matching API
Settings > Fonts replaces UI fonts from BifrOSt's font library

Wave 2 (theme-14, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Assistant app exists but gives text views no rewrite or proofread hook

gaps: TextKit layout manager and text containers
Paragraph styles, text lists, tables and attachments in attributed text
Writing Tools integration for text views
